items.title: Establish the protected daily-lock control plane
acceptance: The strict TypeScript build and deterministic tests must pass.
The 0.5 percent objective must scale from the usable pot.
Operator and model authority tokens must remain separate.
Entry sizing must be stop-defined.
Protected entry and partial re-arm must be durable.
UUID replay, conflict detection, and restart durability must be proven.
The paired Hermes profile contract must exist.
evidence: Gateway foundation merged on main at 9523969756d451ddc371a5d542498dadafd325ee.
Paired profile foundation merged on main at 9d465211369cee1eb8d8cbfa4023948ab6bba63e.
The smoke evidence used 1,000 USD equity, a 5 USD objective, a 450 USD protected entry, 4.95 USD planned loss, an 8.54 USD net target outcome, and a 1,005 USD active protected-equity floor.
Strict build and deterministic control-plane tests passed before merge.
items.notes: This item establishes control-plane correctness, not venue or profitability acceptance.

items.title: Accept the first production venue adapter
acceptance: The official capability contract must be recorded.
Read-only endpoint authority must be explicit and fail closed.
Credentials and signatures must not enter retained evidence.
Authenticated fee and precision discovery must be implemented and evidenced.
Public order-book continuity must be replay-proven.
Private account and order state plus restart reconciliation must be replay-proven.
Continuous public and private transport evidence must be captured.
Native protected entry and exact order ownership must be accepted.
Ambiguous transport and restart recovery must be accepted.
evidence: Binance USD-M shadow discovery and supervised public/private stream code are on main.
Futures Testnet run 32788614491 recorded 111 public messages, one snapshot, zero reconnects, zero stream errors, contiguous sequence, and a ready non-crossed replay.
The USD-M order book now accepts snapshot overlap and enforces pu equal to the previous u after synchronization.
The observed public fixture is frozen at tests/fixtures/binance-usdm/observed-testnet-public.jsonl with canonical evidence SHA-256 0b1053f5607bfc9354e4744f993f42637dada8902b5982f69319c5b279dd2ab7.
Windows strict build and 34 of 34 deterministic tests passed after the direct-main public-evidence integration.

Commit 5a784f6 implements a dormant Testnet/loopback-only protected mutation kernel with deterministic native identities, evidence-before-mutation, exact-query reconciliation, stop-before-target proof, and exact-quantity emergency flattening.
Windows strict build and 47 of 47 deterministic tests passed for the protected mutation contract, including partial-entry flattening and GET-only restart reconstruction.

Commit 0b5b41b implements an authenticated GET-only Testnet preflight that fails closed on production, missing credentials, unsafe account configuration, existing exposure/orders, and malformed private snapshots.
Windows strict build and 53 of 53 deterministic tests passed after the Testnet preflight source increment.
GitHub issue #5 records the source evidence while retaining authenticated Testnet preflight execution and bounded mutation acceptance as open gates.
The 2026-08-24 Binance WebSocket migration was applied: constructed depth, regular-market, and user-data sockets now use the official /public, /market, and /private routes.

A bounded credential-free Futures Testnet probe observed live BTCUSDT depthUpdate and markPriceUpdate events on the routed public and market endpoints; authenticated private routing remains unobserved.
Windows strict build and 55 of 55 deterministic tests passed after route construction and route assertions were added.

Commit a36fabe adds a separate credential-free raw-market recorder for BTCUSDT aggregate trades and 1-second mark price with strict identity inspection, bounded JSONL retention, finite capture, and content-addressed verification.

The retained 15.016-second production-public fixture contains 245 aggregate trades and 12 mark-price updates in one contiguous lifecycle with zero errors, backoffs, invalid messages, non-increasing trade IDs, or non-monotonic per-family event times; canonical SHA-256 07185347c6e1f6bdc0f2900b026f49d753d41c6de573904e4c7d8315669eb48c.
Windows strict build and 60 of 60 deterministic tests passed after freezing the raw-market fixture.

Commit 6e1f7e3 adds a finite Futures-Testnet-only authenticated private evidence gate: preflight before listen-key creation, bounded local capture, complete private lifecycle and reconciliation requirements, fully applied user events, deterministic replay, and a content-addressed manifest without raw account values.
The private evidence command rejects missing credentials before transport; no Binance credential or endpoint environment variables were present for an external run.
Windows strict build and 63 of 63 deterministic tests passed for the dormant private evidence gate.

Commit 0a3423d adds a dormant protected-position close lifecycle: exact reduce-only close proof precedes exact target/stop cancellation, ambiguous close preserves both protections, cancellation ambiguity remains nonterminal, and restart reconciliation is GET-only.
Windows strict build and 68 of 68 deterministic tests passed for protected close ordering, ambiguity handling, exact cleanup identity, restart reconstruction, and credential-free DELETE evidence.
No Binance credential was used and no venue mutation occurred; authenticated Testnet runtime acceptance remains pending explicit read-only evidence approval followed by separate mutation approval.

Commit 024fe7b adds version-2 exact raw-frame market provenance with connection identity, exchange and dual receive clocks, provider sequence identity, inspection version, SHA-256 integrity, explicit version-1 legacy classification, and fail-closed tamper verification.

A credential-free 8.010-second Futures Testnet capture retained 37 aggregate trades and 7 mark-price updates as 44 replay-grade messages on one connection with zero errors, backoffs, invalid messages, hash mismatches, payload mismatches, identity mismatches, unattributed connections, or receive-order faults; canonical SHA-256 be102c024e52d8265857c41683504cc7f5a5609f01295c0f69fcf8e77173f5db.
Windows strict build and 72 of 72 deterministic tests passed after freezing the replay-grade Testnet provenance fixture.

Commit 484a0eb adds version-2 exact raw-frame public-depth provenance before parsing, strict depth identity, shared integrity verification, connection and dual-clock attribution, explicit legacy classification, and separate parsed-book versus exact-depth replay claims.

A credential-free 8.080-second Futures Testnet capture retained 27 replay-grade depth frames on one connection plus one parsed REST snapshot, with zero errors, backoffs, hash mismatches, payload mismatches, identity mismatches, unattributed connections, or receive-order faults; canonical SHA-256 99c1ac43c95bb7e1890a6feca7e028ebf3ed0da3e40bcf0568db3279cc232467.
Windows strict build and 76 of 76 deterministic tests passed after freezing the replay-grade Testnet depth fixture.

Commit c8ddd12 adds immutable version-3 exact public REST depth-bootstrap evidence before parsing, chronological pairing to the normalized snapshot, and separate parsed-book, exact-frame, and exact-session replay claims.

A credential-free 8.065-second Futures Testnet capture retained one exact REST bootstrap paired to one parsed snapshot plus 34 replay-grade depth frames on one connection, with zero errors, backoffs, hash, payload, update, request, pairing, attribution, or receive-order faults; canonical SHA-256 b6063706916aa5b9ec2784a9b0bb4b4359d47be03f9a6ff2527c89c4522afb07.
Windows strict build and 81 of 81 deterministic tests passed after freezing the exact Testnet depth-session fixture.

Commit 8683b88 adds the non-authorizing Phase K execution-context compiler: fresh preflight, depth, market, and private account truth must agree before a bounded Testnet entry exercise can be described as ready.

Private state v2 separates reconciliation observation time from provider event/transaction time and invalidates snapshot-only available balance on ACCOUNT_UPDATE; market status v2 resets current mark/trade summaries on every connection.

The context fails closed on stale, future, missing, disconnected, gapped, crossed, expired, buffered, mismatched, exposed, active-order, balance, fee, leverage, and instrument-contract conditions while retaining mutation_authority=false and engine_binding_authority=false.
Windows strict build and 85 of 85 deterministic tests passed for Phase K.
GitHub issue #5 evidence: https://github.com/GlitchTrader/glitch-crypto/issues/5#issuecomment-5404687950.

Commit f49138a implements dormant Phase L protected revision: exact current-pair proof, optional exact reduce-only partial, exact decimal remaining quantity, replacement stop before target, old target-before-stop cleanup, and GET-only restart reconciliation.

The Phase L state machine never removes old protection before the new stop and target are proven; rejected, partial, ambiguous, or unproven management outcomes retain native reduce-only protection and remain nonterminal.

Execution-context capability truth is version 2: partial reduction and protected stop/target replacement are implemented, native Algo amendment remains unsupported, and generic full close after revisions remains pending.
Windows strict build and 97 of 97 deterministic tests passed for Phase L.
GitHub issue #5 evidence: https://github.com/GlitchTrader/glitch-crypto/issues/5#issuecomment-5404791210.
Commit 1087fa6 implements dormant Phase M generic owned-position close against the exact current protection pair and remaining quantity rather than original-entry quantity or identifiers.

The Phase M state machine proves the exact current stop and target before one deterministic reduce-only close, proves the complete close before cleanup, and cancels target before stop; rejected, partial, ambiguous, or unproven outcomes retain both protections.

Execution-context capability truth is version 3: generic current-owned full close is implemented while native Algo amendment remains unsupported and private position ownership binding remains pending.
Windows strict build and 104 of 104 deterministic tests passed for Phase M.
GitHub issue #5 evidence: https://github.com/GlitchTrader/glitch-crypto/issues/5#issuecomment-5404845499.

Commit 9a2b629 implements Phase N durable OwnedProtectionState with canonical request staging before transport, SHA-256 integrity, compare-and-set writer versioning, restart-safe pending reconciliation, and proof-gated current-pointer transitions.

Phase N also compiles a deeply immutable non-authorizing OwnedProtectionBinding from the durable pointer, fresh one-way private position truth, no unowned active ordinary order, and exact active reduce-only stop/target Algo evidence.

Ambiguity cannot be downgraded to rejection; changed staged bodies, stale writers, corrupt storage, stream degradation, unowned exposure, and symbol, direction, quantity, geometry, activity, freshness, or identity contradictions fail closed.
Windows strict build and 113 of 113 deterministic tests passed for Phase N.
GitHub issue #5 evidence: https://github.com/GlitchTrader/glitch-crypto/issues/5#issuecomment-5404982849.

Commit 835add5 implements the Phase O non-authorizing ProtectedEntryPlan compiler from fresh venue context, UTC daily state, operator policy, and requested direction/stop/target; model quantity is not accepted.

Phase O sizes from executable best ask/bid, exact venue/policy tick and quantity steps, venue/policy minimums, configured leverage, available margin, trade/open-risk limits, daily loss, and active protected-equity floor.

Applied costs cannot undercut the authenticated taker-fee round trip and include stressed exit cost; conservative rounding floors balances/risk budget and rounds notional, margin, and planned loss upward.
Current equity activates a newly earned daily floor during compilation, while changing the daily target leaves entry geometry unchanged for identical risk inputs.
Windows strict build and 122 of 122 deterministic tests passed for Phase O, including 100, 1000, and 10000 USDT scaling fixtures.
GitHub issue #5 evidence: https://github.com/GlitchTrader/glitch-crypto/issues/5#issuecomment-5405160697.

Commit 6272fc7 implements a dormant bounded Testnet orchestrator with a proof-hash-bound one-intent permit, in-process exclusion, durable compare-and-swap staging before effects, and proof-gated state application.

Effect failure preserves the pending request; restart recovery performs only exact reconciliation for protected entry, protection revision, or owned full close. Executable orchestration remains limited to protected entry and owned full close until a separate management-risk plan is accepted.
Windows strict build and 129 of 129 deterministic tests passed for Phase P.
GitHub issue #5 evidence: https://github.com/GlitchTrader/glitch-crypto/issues/5#issuecomment-5405293149.
Commit f434e2d implements a non-authorizing ProtectionManagementPlan from a fresh exact ownership binding plus fresh authenticated GET-only Testnet account, position, market, contract, and fee truth.

The plan derives an optional partial from a requested percentage on the effective venue/policy step, prices LONG reduction at bid and SHORT reduction at ask, and blocks any result that weakens total protected equity or violates remaining minimums, open risk, daily loss, or the active floor.

The dormant orchestrator now accepts protection revision only from a ready immutable management plan plus a separate permit bound to the complete plan hash and current position quantity; durable staging still precedes effects and restart recovery remains GET-only.
Windows strict build and 138 of 138 deterministic tests passed for Phase Q.
GitHub issue #5 evidence: https://github.com/GlitchTrader/glitch-crypto/issues/5#issuecomment-5405399318.
items.stop_line: Do not use production credentials, submit a venue mutation, deploy, or claim production acceptance without explicit human authorization and the remaining evidence gates.
items.notes: Binance USD-M public Futures Testnet transport, exact REST depth bootstrap, parsed depth replay, exact depth-frame provenance, and replay-grade aggregate-trade/mark-price provenance are accepted as sub-gates. Protected entry, original-entry close, partial reduction, stop-first protection replacement, generic current-owned close, durable ownership state, private-position/protection binding, venue-exact entry planning, management-risk planning, authenticated preflight, fail-closed non-authorizing contexts, and a bounded single-writer Testnet orchestrator are implemented only as deterministic source. No Testnet credential was used. Authenticated private evidence, observed Testnet mutations, runtime selection and permit issuance, native fill/protection acceptance, mainnet eligibility, and production selection remain pending.

items.title: Build event replay and calibrated opportunity baselines
acceptance: Event-time replay must include costs, latency, nonfills, and partial fills.
Fill and target-before-stop models must be calibrated.
Frozen holdout and shadow baselines must exist.
items.blocked_reason: GC-002 is not done; authenticated venue and execution evidence are prerequisites for factual replay semantics.
items.notes: Do not attribute profitability to an LLM before numerical and no-trade baselines exist.

items.title: Run shadow A/B and a bounded real-money canary
acceptance: The hybrid policy must be compared with the numerical-only baseline.
Any mutation smoke test must use explicitly approved bounded disposable capital.
Protected live outcomes must reconcile fees and slippage.
Promotion must remain reversible.
items.stop_line: Real credentials, venue mutation, live capital, and production promotion require explicit human approval at the time of action.
items.blocked_reason: GC-002 and GC-003 are not done, and the paired Hermes candidate and position workers are not accepted.
items.notes: Tests and architecture do not imply that this item is safe to begin.
